verdict.rationale: Steel is built for headless, programmatic automation. The Sessions API spins up isolated cloud browsers on demand, the official CLI runs full browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal, and there is an OpenAPI spec, a pre-built Docker image, and Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium connectivity. Together these cover unattended headless use well. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, non-interactive API-key auth via environment variables), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs.
